title: _autobegin() in connection (check Session also) does not guard against reentrant behavior

labels.name: engine
labels.description: engines, connections, transactions, isolation levels, execution options

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

body:
**Describe the bug**
In 1.3.x, the guidance here https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/13/dialects/sqlite.html#serializable-isolation-savepoints-transactional-ddl worked perfectly. However, once I upgraded to 1.4 and put future in the engine I am now getting a recursion error. The page still exists in the 14 docs with a minor syntax change so it led me to believe it would still work.

**Expected behavior**
Tests using an in memory sqlite database engine should still work under 1.4 future mode.

**To Reproduce**
Run this in pytest:

```py
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, event, Column, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

Base = declarative_base()


def get_engine():
    engine = create_engine(
        url="sqlite:///:memory:?cache=shared",
        future=True,
        echo=True,
        connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
        poolclass=StaticPool,
    )

    # See https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/14/dialects/sqlite.html#serializable-isolation-savepoints-transactional-ddl
    @event.listens_for(engine, "connect")
    def do_connect(dbapi_connection, connection_record):
        # disable pysqlite's emitting of the BEGIN statement entirely.
        # also stops it from emitting COMMIT before any DDL.
        dbapi_connection.isolation_level = None

        # sqlite does not enforce foreign key constraints by default
        dbapi_connection.execute("pragma foreign_keys=ON")

    @event.listens_for(engine, "begin")
    def do_begin(conn):
        # emit our own BEGIN
        conn.exec_driver_sql("BEGIN")

    return engine


class Table1(Base):
    __tablename__ = "table1"

    only_column = Column(String, primary_key=True)


def test_example():
    engine = get_engine()
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
```
